scope: FR-06/FR-08 full unchanged public Transformer PDF through PaperUploads and normal paper_summary capability
acceptance_client: normal provider with local completed-call checkpoints, keyed by exact request and model

predeclared_review.criterion: Do not assign the two Transformer training costs to EN-DE only, or call the EN-FR cells empty; the original values span the cost-column group. Report the uncertainty or omit language attribution.
Table 3 B changes d_k to 16 or 32 only; d_v stays inherited base 64. Do not claim d_k=d_v=16/32.
Full 15-page input includes appendix text/captions on pages 13-15. Distinguish unavailable visual interpretation from a false claim that appendix text was not provided.

Table 3 N=2/4/6/8 rows inherit the base configuration except N; preserve PPL/BLEU pairs 6.11/23.7, 5.19/25.3, 4.92/25.8, 4.88/25.5. Lower PPL is better; higher BLEU is better. N=8 improves PPL but lowers BLEU relative to N=6; do not attach a blanket multifactor warning to N-only rows.
The big row changes model width, feed-forward width, heads, dropout and training steps; do not attribute its result to a single changed variable.
Table 3 numbers are English-to-German newstest2013 development results and per-wordpiece PPL, distinct from newstest2014 test results and per-word perplexity.
The final report links the relevant knowledge unit to original physical PDF page 9 for Table 3.
The unscaled qualifier belongs to dot-product attention rather than additive attention.
Positional encoding method comes from physical page 6; learned-position ablation values come from physical page 9; paragraph support preserves both when both are discussed.
The three Transformer attention applications retain physical page 5 support for their detailed description, rather than citing physical page 3 alone.

Do not expose internal material chunk-completion narration; preserve the source conflict of 41.8 versus 41.0 when discussing it; distinguish figures/captions and extracted text from unperformed visual analysis.

pipeline.reported_scope: 已检查 PDF 的全部 15 个物理页，其中 15 页有足量可提取文字。旋转文字的排版与阅读顺序可能不准确。图像、公式及复杂表格未做视觉识别。

quality_review.method: Manual comparison of generated Markdown and saved knowledge units against the preserved original physical PDF pages and reader evidence. All eleven checks were fixed before execution.

checks.evidence: The two Transformer rows each have one cost centered across the two language cost columns. The post-review knowledge and final report assign these values to EN-DE and say the EN-FR cells are absent.
The report applies the caption’s inheritance rule, gives base d_v=64 and describes changing d_k alone to 16 or 32. It keeps both PPL/BLEU pairs and does not change d_v.
All 15 physical pages have usable text. Figure 3–5 captions are described with page citations and separated from visual inspection.
The four PPL/BLEU pairs are retained with baseline inheritance. N=8 improves PPL but lowers BLEU compared with N=6, without a multifactor warning for the layer-only rows.
Width, feed-forward width, head count, dropout and training steps all differ from the base; the report does not claim a single change caused the result.
The report distinguishes newstest2014 test BLEU from English-to-German newstest2013 development metrics and identifies per-wordpiece perplexity.
The methods resolve Table 3 evidence to actual physical page 9.
The main attention explanation and its source unit correctly identify unscaled dot-product attention. The closing synthesis drops the unscaled qualifier and broadens the comparison.
The method cites page 6, and the paragraph combining the learned-encoding ablation with the sinusoidal rationale cites both the experiment and method.
The three attention applications are described with the source unit citing physical page 5.
The report preserves the 41.0 versus 41.8 difference, distinguishes caption text from visual analysis and omits internal chunk processing narration. The cost error is counted in its own criterion.

quality_review.conclusion: Complete material review and column hints improve the predeclared checks for this PDF. The merged training-cost columns remain misattributed in the knowledge unit and report, and the closing synthesis loses the attention comparison qualifier.
